chunks: He said: Abul Hasan Ali ibn Muhammad al-Katib reported to me from al-Hasan ibn Ali al-Zafarani, who reported from Ibrahim ibn Muhammad al-Thaqafi, who reported from Ismail ibn Aban, who reported from Fadhl ibn al-Zubair, from Imran ibn Mitham, from Abayah al-Asadi, who said: I heard Ali, peace be upon him, say:
"I am the master of the aged ones, and in me is a tradition from Ayyub (Job). By Allah, God will surely gather my family for me, just as they were gathered for Yaqub (Jacob)."

key_terms.أهلي: My family, referring to Ahl al-Bayt, the Prophet's household
key_terms.سنة من أيوب: The tradition/way of Ayyub (Job), referring to prophetic patience through suffering
key_terms.سيد الشيب: Master of the aged ones, a title indicating leadership and honor among elders

ai.seo_question: What did Imam Ali say about his similarity to Prophet Ayyub and Prophet Yaqub?
ai.summary: Imam Ali (AS) draws a parallel between himself and the prophets Ayyub (Job) and Yaqub (Jacob). He declares himself the master of the aged and states that, like Job who endured great suffering, he too bears trials with patience. He expresses certainty that God will reunite his family, as He reunited Jacob with his sons after their long separation. This reflects Imam Ali's awareness of the tribulations awaiting his household (Ahl al-Bayt) and his faith in their eventual reunion by divine will.

en.mulla-asgharali-m-m-jaffer: 4. He said: Abul Hasan ‘Ali ibn Muhammad al-Katib reported to me from al-Hasan ibn ‘Ali al-Zafarani, who reported from Ibrahim ibn Muhammad al-Thaqafi, who reported from Ismail ibn Aban, who reported from Fadhl ibn al-Zubair, from Imran ibn Mitham, from Abayah al-Asadi, who said: I heard ‘Ali, peace be upon him, say:
"I am the master of the aged ones. And in me is the tradition of Ayyub (i.e. his sufferings), and by Allah, He will gather together my family for me, the way He did for Ya’qooibn"
